[[Tom Wayland]] ([[DP161]]-[[DP177]]) |java=[[Yoshinori Sonobe]] |}} '''Mr. Sukizo''' (Japanese: '''スキゾーさん''' ''Mr. Sukizō'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is the [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman|President]] of the [[Pokémon Fan Club]] and, along with [[Raoul Contesta|Mr. Contesta]] and [[Nurse Joy]], one of the [[Contest Judge|judges]] of [[Pokémon Contest]]s. He first appeared in ''[[AG013|All Things Bright and Beautifly!]]''. His appearance resembles that of a male {{tc|Poké Fan}}, which may have served as inspiration for his design. ==In animation== ===History=== ====''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]''==== Mr. Sukizo debuted in a non-speaking appearance in ''[[AG013|All Things Bright and Beautifly!]]'', where he was the judge of the [[Rustboro City]] [[Pokémon Contest]]. At the start of the competition, the [[Contest announcer|announcer]] introduced him as the President of the {{pkmn|Fan Club|Pokémon Enthusiasts Club}}. Later, during the first round, Mr. Sukizo showed disappointment upon seeing the presentation of [[Jessie|Mademoiselle Jessica]], who failed to display the [[move]]s and skills of her {{TP|Jessie|Seviper}}. As such, he gave her a zero. [[File:Officer Jenny Mr Sukizo Nurse Joy.png|thumb|left|220px|Mr. Sukizo in the Dress-Up Contest]] During the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]] of the [[Rank (Contest)|R1]] {{to|Rubello}} Contest in ''[[AG078|Cruisin' for a Losin']]'', Mr. Sukizo ruled {{DL|Fainting|Battle Off}} for [[May's Bulbasaur]] during her match against [[Savannah]]'s {{p|Lairon}}. He showed indignation when {{an|May}}, ignoring his ruling and her Pokémon's health, insisted Bulbasaur was able to continue battling. ====''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''==== In ''[[DP033|All Dressed Up With Somewhere To Go!]]'', Mr. Sukizo judged the [[Pokémon Dress-Up Contest]], an annual {{pkmn|cosplay}} {{cat|Pokémon competitions|competition}} organized by fellow members of the Pokémon Fan Club. Together with [[Officer Jenny]] and [[Nurse Joy]], he evaluated the costumes and impressions of the contestants' Pokémon. At the end of the competition, he awarded the winner, {{an|Brock}}, with a [[Pokémon Egg]] that would eventually hatch into a {{TP|Brock|Happiny}}. In ''[[DP163|Fighting Ire with Fire!]]'', Mr. Sukizo was revealed to be a member of the {{pkmn|Activities Committee|Pokémon Contest Grand Festival Planning Committee}}, along with [[Raoul Contesta]] and [[Marian]]. During the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]] of the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]] in ''[[DP174|Last Call — First Round!]]'', he and the Nurse Joy from [[Pastoria City]] were put in charge of evaluating the performances delivered by {{pkmn|Coordinator}}s in the Green Stage. [[File:Mr Sukizo debut.png|thumb|220px|Mr. Sukizo in his debut with a different outfit]] ===Character=== Aside from presiding the [[Pokémon Fan Club]], Mr. Sukizo is a member of the panel of judges for [[Pokémon Contest]]s and related events, such as the various [[Grand Festival]] tournaments and the {{cat|Multiregional competitions|multiregional}} [[Wallace Cup]]. He is a man of few words and, whenever the [[Contest announcer|master of ceremonies]] asks for his input, he makes brief comments, usually ending his sentences by saying the subject is "Remarkable!" (Japanese: {{tt|好きですね|Sukidesu ne}} ''I like it!''). Whether he is talking about the hosting city or about a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}'s overall performance, he will not take long to express his opinion. Despite this, it is clear that he enjoys his work as a [[Contest Judge]] as much as [[Raoul Contesta|Mr. Contesta]] and [[Nurse Joy]] do. ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{contest color}}|bordercolor={{contest color light}} |de=Gerd Meyer |ja=園部好徳 ''[[Yoshinori Sonobe]]'' |en=[[Darren Dunstan]] ([[AG035]]-[[AG144]])
